buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Certificates

Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 6. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 7. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Manpower to be reduced in case of posting/promotion of concern category to this Headquarters during the contract period. 2. Outsourced manpower will not be intoxicated by consumption of liquor/drugs or any unauthorised item s while on duty. 3. Outsourced manpower should be in a proper dress while on duty. 4. Contractor shall also abide, by the provisions of the Child Labour Act 1986. No labourer below the age of 18 years shall be employed on the work. 5. Cook is contracted to prepare all meals (including tea). 6. Contractor shall arrange for such facilities as provided for in the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act for the welfare and health of the labour employee on the work. 7. Monthly salary slip should be given to employee complete details of pay and allowance. 8. The contractor has to provide photo identity card to the personnel deployed at Headquarter Recruiting Zone, Bangalore. 9. This Headquarter Recruiting Zone, Bangalore can dismiss or remove the site of service any person or p ersons employed by the contractor who may be incompetent, discipline and misconduct. 10. It is the contractor responsibility to provide relief of any individual taking leave. Non provision of timel

y relief will be unacceptable. 11. The contractor will ensure that all persons required to be provided as per contract is made available t o Headquarter Recruiting Zone at all time. 12. Termination of Contract. The Headquarter Recruiting Zone, Bangalore shall have right to terminate thi s contract under the following conditions :- 12.1 Unsatisfactory service. 12.2 Discipline issues created by the person outsourced. 12.3 Any breach of military security. 12.4 A warning letter will be issued to the contractor in case of any breach of contract. In case the c ontractor fails to resolve the issue or comply with the terms and conditions of the contract his contract ma y terminated at the discretion of Headquarter Recruiting Zone. .
